p: A 17th-century palace, today mainly used by the Royal College of Music.
Has a collection of more than a hundred motorcycles.

15 km north of central Stockholm, Sollentuna’s rather traditionalist Edsbacka Krog used to be the only Swedish restaurant with two stars in the Michelin Guide Rouge. Extensive wine list. Mains 370-420 kr, menus 750-1200 kr.
